conclusion: The one-step E_p identity holds at layer 0 (resid/|E_p| = 1.20e-02 with the corrected downstream term). It fails at layers 1 and 2 because the omitted V.dT term and the second-order dV.dT term dominate there. Layer 2 operates in a large-step regime (|E_p| = 222.98), where a one-step LINEAR identity is not expected to close. C1 is therefore a layer-0 result, not a global one.
limits: Single seed (0), 4 samples, width 32/64. No seed or width sweep for this identity.
retract=False removes the Stiefel-retraction confound; the shipped path retracts.
The second-order dV.dT term is INFERRED as the remainder; only the sum is measured.
Module uses D_d = relu; the paper benchmarks use D_d = I. Both arms reported in probe_ep_c1_fixed.py: layer 0 holds at 1.20e-02 (relu) and 5.89e-02 (I).
